ip_blocked.label: Sending IP blocked
ip_blocked.description: The IP address of the sending side's mail server is on a blacklist. Request delisting from the blacklist provider and review the mail that caused the listing.

rate_limited.label: Rate limited
rate_limited.description: The recipient domain limits large volumes of mail sent in a short time. Lower the sending rate and the number of concurrent connections, then resend later.

auth_failure.label: Sender authentication failed
auth_failure.description: SPF, DKIM, DMARC or reverse DNS checks failed. Check the DNS records of the sending domain and the configuration of the sending side's mail server.

sender_blocked.label: Sender address rejected
sender_blocked.description: The recipient domain rejects mail from this sender address. Ask the recipient domain administrator to unblock the address, or review the sender address.

content_rejected.label: Content rejected
content_rejected.description: The body or an attachment was rejected as spam, as a virus or by policy. Review the content and the attachments.

message_too_large.label: Message too large
message_too_large.description: The message exceeds the recipient's size limit. Make the attachments smaller or share the files another way.

server_config.label: Sending server misconfigured
server_config.description: Relay, TLS or HELO settings do not meet the recipient's requirements. Check the configuration of the sending side's mail server (MTA).

dns_resolver_failure.label: DNS resolver failure (sending side's mail server)
dns_resolver_failure.description: The sending side's mail server cannot resolve the recipient's name in DNS and cannot deliver, although the name exists. Check the name resolution of the sending side's mail server (resolv.conf, caching DNS, port 53, DNSSEC and so on).

unknown_failure.label: Unknown failure
unknown_failure.description: A delivery failure that matches no known pattern. Check the diagnostic and the original message, and see the analysis report if needed.

dmarc_spf_missing.label: SPF record missing
dmarc_spf_missing.description: Mail with this domain in From was sent from a domain without a usable SPF record (such as the sending server's host name) and failed DMARC. If the mail is sent from a server of this domain, publish an SPF record and set up DKIM signing.

dmarc_dkim_failed.label: DKIM verification failed
dmarc_dkim_failed.description: Mail signed with the DKIM key of this domain failed verification and DMARC. Either forwarding on the receiving side broke the signature, or the DKIM setup on the sending side is wrong. Check the sending IPs.

dmarc_not_authenticated.label: Sender not authenticated
dmarc_not_authenticated.description: Mail with this domain in From was sent from IP addresses with neither a DKIM signature nor SPF authorization, and failed DMARC. Check the sending IPs to tell a legitimate service missing from SPF from spoofing.

user_unknown.label: Recipient does not exist
user_unknown.description: The recipient address does not exist. Remove the address from the recipient list or ask the recipient for the correct address.

mailbox_full.label: Recipient mailbox full
mailbox_full.description: The recipient's mailbox is full. Nothing can be done on the sending side; mail is delivered once the recipient address owner frees up space.

mailbox_disabled.label: Recipient address disabled
mailbox_disabled.description: The recipient address is disabled or suspended. Remove the address from the recipient list or ask the recipient for another address.

domain_not_found.label: Recipient domain not found
domain_not_found.description: No DNS (MX) record was found for the recipient domain. Check the spelling; if the spelling is correct, wait for the DNS of the recipient side to recover.

dns_failure_external.label: DNS failure (receiving side or external)
dns_failure_external.description: A failed name lookup was reported, but the cause is the DNS of the recipient side or the external server that issued the notice. Nothing can be done on the sending side. Contact the recipient domain administrator only if the problem persists.

delivery_delay.label: Delivery delayed
delivery_delay.description: The recipient server is temporarily unreachable and delivery is delayed. Mail is normally resent automatically; contact the recipient domain administrator only if the delay persists.

probeResolveReason.arrived_elsewhere: Arrived but was filed into another folder

tools.description: Run fetch, grouping and analysis separately or together. Index rebuild, reclassification and cleanup also run from here.
tools.allNote: With "All mailboxes", one job is created per mailbox, and the jobs run in parallel up to the number of concurrent jobs.

sync.title: Sync all (fetch, group, analyze)
sync.description: Fetches mail, groups new bounces and analyzes the actionable groups. Same as a scheduled sync.

fetch.title: Fetch only
fetch.description: Saves messages not yet fetched from the IMAP server. No grouping or analysis.

group.title: Group only
group.description: Classifies fetched messages awaiting grouping, groups them and analyzes the groups awaiting analysis.

analyze.title: Analyze only
analyze.description: Runs the cause analysis by the AI agent, either for groups awaiting analysis or for all actionable groups.

reindex.title: Rebuild index
reindex.description: Rebuilds the index and re-reads, re-classifies and re-groups every stored original message.
reindex.warning: This takes time. Group states and analysis reports are kept only for groups that are created again.

reclassify.title: Reclassify
reclassify.description: Keeps the messages and redoes only bounce classification and grouping. Run after the classification method is updated or the sending sources are changed.

cleanup.title: Cleanup
cleanup.description: Deletes from the IMAP server the notices past the retention of each mailbox and the junk mail (except notices recognized by subject or sender name alone, and automatically generated messages). Also deletes messages past the mail retention, temporary files left by interrupted writes, old working directories and jobs finished more than 30 days ago. Runs automatically every day at the cleanup time.
cleanup.warning: Messages deleted from the IMAP server cannot be restored. Groups left without messages are deleted along with the analysis reports.

jobs.description: Background processing such as fetching, grouping and analysis. Active jobs update automatically. Jobs run for "All mailboxes" appear as one job per mailbox.

settings.description: Manage system settings. Open the profile from the user name at the top right.
